podcast.body: A 2018 song credited to 21 different people, some of whom were deceased. Due to a "sample of a sample" within the song, all eight members of Wu-Tang Clan also receive income from this track. "In the case of Drake, his 2018 song, Nice for What, was written by 21 different people, and they were brought in all for different reasons."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: In 2018, this song replaced Drake's "God's Plan" at number one. Later, after a few other singles, it returned to number one before being ejected by Drake's own "In My Feelings," showcasing his dominance in 2018. "Drake's own God's Plan was replaced by Nice For What. Later, after a few other singles took turns at number one, Nice For What came back to number one, and was then ejected by his own in my feelings."
